description: Class, route, and the human who confirmed it. Produced by defect-triage for both Realize test-cycle defects and Run/hypercare live incidents — same schema, different intake.

item_reference.description: Ticket/defect ID and its source (Realize test-cycle or Run/hypercare incident queue).

upstream_classification_present.description: If false, classification must be 'Blocked — pending intake' and every field below except this one and item_reference stays empty.

decision_log_row_id.description: Cited verbatim, or 'none found' if untraceable.

reported_behavior_vs_decision.description: Whether the reported behavior matches or deviates from what the Row ID says was decided.

reasoning.description: Must cite the Row ID comparison, not the symptom alone. N/A if Blocked.

confidence.description: Meaning depends on classification: for Bug/Spec flaw, confidence in the classification; for Untraceable, confidence that no Row ID actually exists; N/A for Blocked.

enum: Session held, pending new Row ID
